lines: Proof-of-stake networks pay stakers to secure the chain
scenes.sub: Proof-of-stake networks pay stakers to secure the chain. You either run a validator or delegate to one. Rewards come from issuance and fees. Risks: slashing (penalties for validator misbehaviour on some networks), unbonding periods (waiting
scenes.vo: Proof-of-stake networks pay stakers to secure the chain. You either run a validator or delegate to one. Rewards come from issuance and fees. Risks: slashing (penalties for validator misbehaviour on some networks), unbonding periods (waiting time to withdraw) and validator downtime.
scenes.cap: Proof-of-stake networks pay stakers to secure the chain. You either run a validator or delegate to one. Rewards come from issuance and fees. Risks: slashing (penalties for validator misbehaviour on some networks), unbonding periods (waiting time to withdraw) and validator downtime.

scenes.title: Worked example
steps: Staking yields a few percent a year in the staked asset (e.g. ~3%,…
Your dollar return is still dominated by the asset's price
scenes.vo: Let's work an example, step by step. Staking yields a few percent a year in the staked asset (for example about 3%, illustrative). Your dollar return is still dominated by the asset's price: +3% staking on an asset that falls 30% is still a large loss. Stake what you'd hold anyway.
scenes.cap: Let's work an example, step by step. Staking yields a few percent a year in the staked asset (e.g. ~3%, illustrative). Your dollar return is still dominated by the asset's price: +3% staking on an asset that falls 30% is still a large loss. Stake what you'd hold anyway.

scenes.title: Checklist
items: Validator/provider chosen on uptime, fee, concentration and record

scenes.q: What do staking rewards pay for?
scenes.vo: Question one. What do staking rewards pay for? [[pause 4]] The answer: Securing the network.
scenes.cap: Question 1. What do staking rewards pay for? The answer: Securing the network.

scenes.a: A waiting period before unstaked assets become transferable.
scenes.vo: Question two. What is unbonding? [[pause 4]] The answer: A waiting period before unstaked assets become transferable.
scenes.cap: Question 2. What is unbonding? The answer: A waiting period before unstaked assets become transferable.

scenes.q: Does staking protect against price falls?
scenes.a: No. It adds a small yield; price moves dominate.
